description: Reports how many visits each AI assistant sent to a site that runs the free OperStack counter. Needs the private token from the counter link, which only the site owner has. Returns visit counts per assistant, not individual visitors.

days.description: How many days back to report. Default 90.

token.description: The private token from your counter link (the part after t=)

name: ai_visits
title: Read your own AI visit counter
